name: Richy Design System
description: Premium financial app design system — expensive, warm, understated wealth. Apple-inspired with data-dense Bloomberg terminal aesthetic.

philosophy.feeling: Smart and calm — not stressful, not gamified, not cluttered
philosophy.warmth: Cream tones and warm materials, never gray or sterile white
philosophy.wealth: Like a real wealth tool — the kind a rich person would actually use
philosophy.personality: Personal and conversational — knows your name, greets you like a person
philosophy.density: Numbers ARE the decoration. Typography and data density create richness
philosophy.restraint: Wealth implied by restraint, not decoration. Premium banking meets Bloomberg terminal

principles: NO emojis. Anywhere. Ever. Not in UI, greetings, categories, or copy
Buttons are short: 'Sign In' not 'Click here to sign in'
Greetings are human and casual: 'Good morning, Alon.' NOT exclamatory
Fill space with information and data, not whitespace and decoration
Shadows are barely-there but present — depth reads as substance
borderRadius: 20-22px on surfaces; 14px on buttons — generous, Apple-style, never square
Titles are an upright editorial serif, never italic — see typography.display

purple.description: Lavender hero with violet accents and dark text

classic.description: Dark hero with warm orange accents and white text — original theme

blue.description: Light periwinkle hero with deep navy accents and dark text — default theme

glass.description: iOS 26-style Liquid Glass material system for nav bars and sheets
glass.mechanism: blur + saturate + specular edge (bright inset top) + soft lift shadow

typography.description: Two families with a strict division of labor: an upright editorial serif carries every title, the platform UI sans carries body copy, controls and all tabular data. Never italic — the app shipped and reverted a bold-italic Garamond pass (2026-08-19 to 2026-08-21) before settling on this upright serif on 2026-08-22.

ui.role: Body copy, labels, buttons, inputs, nav, all numbers
ui.fontFamily: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

display.role: Every title and headline, app-wide — screen headers, sheet titles, onboarding headlines, Richard's markdown-style headers
display.fontFamily: "New York", "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, Georgia, "Noto Serif Hebrew", "Noto Naskh Arabic", ui-serif, "Times New Roman", serif
display.note: Localized headings (Hebrew/Arabic) keep the same editorial role via the bundled Noto serif companions in the stack, not a separate font.

mark.role: The 'R' logotype mark only (RichyLogo, error boundary, boot splash) — not used for titles

motion.description: Richy Motion — one vocabulary for everything that moves, shipped 2026-08-09. Durations and curves live as CSS custom properties (never literal ms/eases at call sites) so --m-scale can retime the whole app, and prefers-reduced-motion collapses it to near-zero without per-call-site checks.
motion.principle: Motion only ever does one of three jobs: content arriving (rcRise), a value changing (rcGrow / rcRowIn / rcNudge / rcFlash), or a moment that has actually earned a celebration (rcPop / rcSweep). Nothing loops forever except a genuine in-progress state (typing dots, analyzing pulse, refresh spinner) — when the work stops, the motion stops.

tokens.--m-stagger: 55ms (per-item entrance delay step, caps at 6 steps)

motion.pressFeedback: Every tappable surface (BigBtn included) tracks pointer down/up/leave/cancel and applies transform: scale(0.975) on press, transitioning via 'transform var(--m-press) ease, box-shadow var(--m-quick) ease'.
motion.growIn: Bars, rings and progress fills render at 0 and animate to value on mount (useGrowIn hook: flips true on next animation frame, with a 50ms setTimeout backstop for backgrounded tabs) rather than snapping to their resting value.
motion.accessibility: *:focus-visible gets a 2.5px solid outline in the active theme's accent colour (3.5px under prefers-contrast:more) — keyboard/AT-only, invisible to mouse and touch.

heroCard.description: Centerpiece of the app — premium banking aesthetic

layout.balanceLabel: NET BALANCE — tiny all-caps label at ~0.1em letter-spacing, theme faintText color
layout.balanceNumber: 42px bold number in theme.hero.text — dark ink (#2A1F4D purple, #242C52 blue) on the two light-hero themes, white only on the dark-hero classic theme; red switches to theme.hero.negative when the balance is negative
layout.savingsRate: green pill badge if ≥20%, orange otherwise
layout.metrics: Income vs Spent side-by-side with separator

interactions.tapToToggle: Net Worth vs Balance via hero pill interaction
interactions.darkMode: Gradients and text colors adapt via theme system

button.pressState: scale(0.975) via the shared PRESS_T motion transition — see motion.pressFeedback

input.description: Most input containers carry no stroke at all — they're a tinted fill, not an outlined field
input.border: none in the overwhelming majority of instances (a 1px T.sep border appears only in a few contexts)
input.borderRadius: 11-13px depending on context (not a fixed value)

navBar.description: Floating bottom tab bar, not a top-cornered edge-to-edge bar
navBar.blur: 28px + saturate(190%) + brightness(1.08) — distinct from the sheet's 30px/saturate(180%)
navBar.glassSpec: inset bright top rim + soft lift shadow
navBar.activeTabs: frosted capsule lens behind selected icon

badges.description: 157-entry badge collection (motivation/achievement layer), shipped 2026-08-14. A distinct document design system for the badge index lives at design-system/motivation-doc/ (tokens.css) — this section covers the in-app rendering.
badges.art: Theme-mode-split SVG per badge at /badges/{light|dark}/{id}.svg — separate light/dark assets, not CSS-recolored. Rarity chroma is baked into the art (a ring) rather than applied by a wrapper.
badges.lockedState: Locked badges show a silhouette + lock icon on T.inputBg, no name shown, with a transparent-placeholder rarity line so the grid baseline still aligns with unlocked tiles.

rarity.rule: One chroma per tier, consistent across light/dark; on dark grounds the ramp LIGHTENS rather than inverting so relative order and legibility hold on both.

epic.light: #8970C6 (pinned to violet across all app themes)

mythicGradient.usage: Animated text-clip gradient shimmer — the one deliberate motion flourish reserved for the top tier; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion

rarity.labels: Uppercase tier name (COMMON / UNCOMMON / RARE / EPIC / LEGENDARY / MYTHIC) at the label type scale

social.description: Directional follow graph, shipped 2026-08-14. Explicitly separate from the household/shared-account system — 'carries no money'; followers/following never see any amount.

screens.socialView: Requests card ('asked to follow you'), plus FOLLOWING · N and FOLLOWERS · N list cards, with an explicit privacy footer
screens.findPeople: Handle claim/lookup only — no directory browse (rules deny listing)

avatar.component: Disc — initials-only circle, no photos anywhere in the social layer
avatar.rule: Cycled by index, not by identity hash

widgets.description: Overview dashboard widgets, shipped 2026-08-15. Up to 6 widgets, section subtitled 'Built by Richard' with a small 3x16px accent bar in T.orange beside the display-serif section header.
shapes: compare — two-column period comparison with a +/-% pill

profile.description: Motivation layer / Profile screen rebuild, shipped 2026-08-13/14. Identity block reordered to XP (left) — LevelMark (center) — Settings gear (right), replacing the old stats-triple.
profile.levelMark: 104x104 ringed avatar: initial on a T.btn gradient circle, an 'LV N' pill anchored at the bottom, ringed by an orange (T.orange) progress arc
sections: This month — Green-Month ring card (T.green/T.gold SVG ring)
profile.rankPill: shield icon + rank text on T.orangeDim background, next to an inline 'Edit profile' pill button

business.description: Business account overview rebuild, shipped 2026-07-31. Uses a 3-panel scrollable hero carousel mirroring the personal Overview hero pattern.
stats: Tax pot — editable per-business profile.taxRate, default 25%, editable via a bottom sheet
business.colorPalette: BIZ_COLORS — 20 colors, distinct from the category COLOR_BANK used elsewhere

darkMode.description: Adaptive light/dark mode that respects theme-specific hero colors
darkMode.implementation: applyDarkMode(dark) called on every render, toggles entire glass/nav/sheet system
darkMode.scrimBlur: 4px blur with 120% saturation on dim backdrop
darkMode.navBarBehavior: frosted glass with adaptive rim highlights and specular sheen

doNotChange: Dark hero balance card (classic theme) or light hero gradients (purple/blue themes)
Primary action colors per theme (orange #C8673A classic, purple #8970C6 for violet, navy #3C4C82 for blue)
Apple system font stack for body copy (no web fonts); upright serif for titles, never italic
Bottom tab bar with SVG icons
warnings: Light-hero themes (purple, blue): hero text is dark, not the primary accent color. #3C4C82 alone is only ~2.3:1 on periwinkle — always check contrast when adding new light-hero themes
Liquid glass effect is subtle by design — avoid increasing blur or saturation beyond documented values
Nav bar behavior requires careful shadow and specular rim tuning per light/dark mode to maintain the lens effect
Never reintroduce italic or bold-weight display type — the app shipped and explicitly reverted that combination

statusBar.light: light content (white text, light icons on dark nav)
statusBar.dark: dark content (dark text, dark icons on light nav)

notes.themeSystem: Themes are runtime-switchable via Profile > Appearance. User choice persisted as 'theme' in Firestore, defaulting to 'blue' (Cornflower Ocean) when unset. Three palettes supported: blue (default), purple, classic. Add new themes by extending THEMES object and THEME_LABELS map.
notes.glassSystem: Comprehensive Liquid Glass material system for iOS 26-style nav bar refraction, pill-shaped active-tab lens, frosted sheets, and adaptive light/dark glass tokens. Never apply static 30% opacity to nav bars — use the glass system tokens instead.
notes.darkMode: Full dark mode support via applyDarkMode(). Glass tokens adapt (bright specs in dark, dark borders in light) to maintain visibility.
notes.accessibility: All text has been checked for WCAG contrast. Light-hero themes use darkened ink (e.g., #242C52) on hero, not the primary color.
notes.componentPackage: A buildable extraction of the simplest visual-atom components (Card, IconBadge, CatBadge, BigBtn, ProgressBar, SVGIcon) lives at design-system/src/ for /design-sync. It intentionally does not include screen-level composites (Profile, Social views, WidgetCard, BadgeTile, BusinessView) — those depend on app state/hooks and aren't meaningful outside the app.
